Plan correctly implements M8 (no flip; migration writes explicit recall_scope to paired groups). Design will be updated post-build to clean up D7 residual text.

SOT internal contradiction: design.md § Research Summary stale text says workgroup mode uses 'existing container.json walker pattern' (filesystem). Cycle-1 M1 supersedes — workgroup mode reads from central DB to avoid filesystem-vs-DB drift (the exact failure class Option B was rejected for). decisions.yaml auto_judgments[4] makes this explicit. Plan correctly reads from DB.

Plan uses string[] (e.g., ['Anthropic','Exa']) instead of design's [{name, uuid}] for workgroups.onecli_secrets. Functional parity: applyOnecliSecrets accepts names OR UUIDs at src/onecli-secrets.ts:181 and the identifierToUuid cache at :54 already amortizes resolution cost across spawns. The simpler string[] form avoids the schema complexity of nested objects in JSON, makes set-workgroup-secrets.ts CLI simpler, and is one less migration step if the format changes later. Design will be updated post-build to reflect actual shape (or kept as documented future optimization).

Surface-level divergence with functional CONFIRMED. Design text 'every auto-paired group's container.json' is informal. The operational condition `workgroup_id !== folder` correctly captures only the codex twin (the case where 'self' would resolve incorrectly). The parent's agent_groups.id IS the workgroups.mnemon_store_id (backfilled to match), so parent's 'self' mode already resolves to the workgroup canonical store. Writing recall_scope: 'workgroup' to the parent is a no-op (same store id resolves either way). Plan correctly omits the redundant write.
